subject: Ledgerly — privacy & security follow-up: DPA / SCC / SOC 2 notes
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@ledgerly.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up from today’s demo — DPA / SOC 2 / next steps

Hi Sara — thanks again for taking the call today, appreciated the walkthrough. I wanted to capture the key compliance/security items you flagged and propose clear next steps so we can keep the procurement timeline moving: 

Summary from our side:
- You mentioned Ledgerly needs a signed DPA and the EU SCCs for EU customers.
- You asked about Redwood’s SOC 2 status, and whether we can surface the report to your security team.
- You indicated Healthcare customers may be in scope later; HIPAA was mentioned but not immediate.

Actions I propose:
1) Can you confirm Ledgerly’s legal/security preference for the SCC module (controller -> processor vs controller -> controller)? That will drive which SCC annex we include in the DPA.
2) If Ledgerly is able to start the vendor security questionnaire, please share the sheet and we’ll get that to our security team. I’ll attach our standard DPA template and a link to the SOC 2 report (redacted) once I have the right recipients.
3) If helpful, we can schedule a short call with Monika (our security lead) and your security contact to walk through any open questions.

Attachments: Draft_DPA_Redwood.docx (blank DPA template for review) — I’ve attached a starter version.

Proposed next milestone: We’d like to have a DPA draft and SCC selection agreed before commercial redlines — target 1 week if feasible.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0132
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@ledgerly.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@ledgerly.com>, security@ledgerly.com
Date: 2027-04-18T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today’s demo — DPA / SOC 2 / next steps

Hi Tessa — great demo, thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below: 

1) SCC preference: Ledgerly is the data controller for our customers; Redwood will be a processor for the service you’ll provide. We expect the controller->processor SCCs (the standard Processor Addendum) for EU processing.

2) SOC 2: We require a current SOC 2 Type II. Redwood’s latest SOC 2 was completed in Dec 2026 — please send the redacted report or a secure link for our security team.

3) HIPAA: Not a hard requirement today, but as you flagged, we may have healthcare customers in the next 6–12 months. Please note that we’d want to understand data residency and encryption policies if that becomes relevant.

4) Vendor questionnaire: I’ve attached the questionnaire we typically use (Ledgerly_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). Our security team (security@ledgerly.com) will start populating it; Tom (cc’d) is our legal lead and will shepherd the DPA review.

Happy to hop on a short call next week if helpful.

Best —
Sara Liu
Head of Partnerships, Ledgerly
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-18T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Ledgerly — DPA / SOC2 ask (next ops/legal steps)

Rishi / Monica — forwarding Ledgerly’s answers from Sara. High level: they want a controller->processor DPA with the processor SCCs; they asked for our SOC 2 Type II (Dec 2026) and have started the vendor questionnaire (attached).

Can you please: 
- Rishi: prepare a DPA draft that maps to controller->processor SCCs and propose whether we should offer the standard Redwood DPA or a slightly amended one for their clauses. I attached the Draft_DPA_Redwood.docx I initially sent — feel free to iterate.
- Monica: please coordinate copy of our SOC 2 redacted report (link file: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026-link.txt) and confirm any additional evidence we should surface (pen test, encryption matrices).

Also recommend we propose a 30-min call between Monika (security) and Ledgerly’s security@ledgerly.com + Tom to walk the questionnaire. Proposed windows next Tue/Wed morning PT.

Att: Ledgerly_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks —
Tessa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Ledgerly — DPA / SOC2 ask (next ops/legal steps)

Thanks Tessa — quick plan from legal/ops side: 

1) DPA/SCC: Legal prefers we start with our standard Redwood DPA with the EU SCCs for controller->processor (we typically use the Commission’s 2021 SCCs where applicable). I’ll draft an annex that explicitly references the controller->processor module and call that out in the header. Will share a version for internal review by EOD 2027-04-20.

2) SOC 2: Monica, please send the secure SOC 2 link to security@ledgerly.com and upload a redacted copy to the Drive link RAIN-PRIV/ledgerly/soc2-2026 so we can track access. Add notes on scoping (what systems are covered) and the last pen-test date.

3) Questionnaire: I’ll coordinate a 30-min sync between Monika (security) and Ledgerly’s security team. Proposed times: Tue 2027-04-20 09:30 PT or Wed 2027-04-21 11:00 PT — Tessa, please check with Sara and book.

4) Commercial: Once DPA language and SCC module are agreed, we’ll proceed to the commercial redlines. For tracking, I’ll add this to HubSpot under deal LED-2024-082 and tag Legal/Privacy.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
